title: Dine-in order
description: The party's order as a set of line items — drafted by the draft_order agent (assist) and confirmed/edited by the server on the manual Take-order task, then re-edited on Revise. Each line carries the price + allergen tags copied from the menu so generate_bill and screen_allergens can read them. Author this schema in the wizard — it is a human/agent-authored artifact, not a tool output. The array of line objects exercises Amendia's repeatable schema-form.

tags.description: Allergen tags copied from the menu item (e.g. ["nuts","dairy"]).
